title: Implement immutable artifact transport and measured Viewer compatibility
note: Native proposal validation, accepted merge and task completion remain separate required gates. This receipt does not mark the backlog complete.
known_limitations: This receipt is not a native completion or merge receipt.
transport.ts and transport.test.ts are untracked working-tree files. site_revision is HEAD before those edits.
artifacts/ is gitignored, so this receipt is on disk and is not part of git status.

Every capability and viewer report records live false and originProof unproven. A caller that passes live true is ignored and listed in ignoredClaims. WWL-082 owns live Pages-origin probes. This suite injects fetch and does not contact huggingface.co or datasets-server.huggingface.co.
CORS is accepted only when Access-Control-Allow-Origin is * or the exact Pages origin. The default origin is https://worldwidelaws.github.io. Credentials are omit. No Authorization header is sent.

Range is accepted only for HTTP 206 whose Content-Range is bytes 0-31/<size> and whose body is at most 32 bytes. A 200 that ignores Range, or Accept-Ranges alone, is not Range. An oversized Content-Length is cancelled before the body is read and recorded as bodyRefused.

COOP and COEP response headers are recorded and ignored. crossOriginIsolationAssumed and sharedArrayBufferAssumed stay false. workerModel is single-thread. A dev-server isolation header is not Pages production evidence.

Outgoing headers are a plain record so Range is not deleted by a Headers implementation that still treats Range as a forbidden name. jsdom does that. The Fetch standard allows Range. This suite does not prove that a production browser attached Range from the Pages origin.

Retries default to 3 and cannot be configured above 4. Retryable statuses are 408, 429, 500, 502, 503, and 504. Backoff starts at 200 ms, doubles, and stops at 8 seconds. Retry-After above 8 seconds fails immediately and is not slept. The last failed attempt does not sleep. Abort becomes cancelled and is not retried. Integrity and revision failures are not retried.
At most 4 requests are in flight. The gate is held for the whole fetch, including capability probes, and is released during backoff.

One transport instance is one search session. Artifact bytes stop at 10 MiB. There is no public budget reset. Unknown-size JSON is reserved at the caller's byte cap, which defaults to 2 MiB and cannot exceed 10 MiB. Parquet of unknown size, or declared above 2 MiB, is refused unless the caller requests an explicit Range slice, the probe measured both CORS and Range, and the slice itself fits the budget. A slice that starts at 0 and covers a declared file larger than the budget is refused. This module does not walk Range slices to rebuild a country file.

Revisions must be 40-hex commits. Branch names such as main are rejected. Trusted response headers are x-repo-commit, x-commit, and x-revision. ETag is not a commit. A resolve URL or an embedded sourceRevision, source_revision, or revision that disagrees with the pin is revision-mismatch or revision-mix. requireConfirmedRevision defaults to false, so a hash-matched body with no commit header is returned as sha256-only and revisionConfirmed false.
A batch that names two revisions of one dataset fails before any request. A failure aborts the other in-flight members of that batch.
Mirrors are HTTPS, at most 3, and only after a CORS-capable probe. A redirect must stay on the mirror host or an allowed Hugging Face host. A missing CORS response blocks the body GET.

Viewer calls use /splits, /rows, /search, and /filter only. /parquet and /is-valid are not called. No revision query is sent. Page length is clamped to 100. A walk stops after 4 pages. One dataset, config, and split keeps at most 400 rows and 2 MiB. The splits budget key is dataset, then *, then *. Payload flags that claim joins or revision pinning are ignored. VIEWER_JOINS_SUPPORTED and VIEWER_REVISION_PIN_SUPPORTED stay false. Stemming is english-porter and is not a complete multilingual index. partial stops the walk. Search and filter are separate requests. A rows page cannot carry a query or a where predicate.

Viewer rows requested against a pin are withheld unless the payload commit equals that pin. A missing commit is viewer-revision-unconfirmed. A different commit is revision-mix. /splits is not treated as a revision pin. requestedRevision is stored on the layout and is not put in the URL.
The Jest reporter counted 14 passing tests. One is the existing setup test in src/__tests__/setup.ts. Thirteen exercise this transport.

CI=1 was set so Jest would not enter watch mode. PATH was exactly /usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin. npm is /usr/bin/npm. HOME was /tmp/ipfs-accelerate-validation-home-wwl040.bdb7uM. XDG paths were $HOME/.cache, $HOME/.config, $HOME/.local/share, and $HOME/.local/state.
The Jest reporter and the Node NO_COLOR and VM Modules warnings were written to stderr, along with the ts-jest isolatedModules deprecation warning. stderr was not empty. The process exit code was 0.
The test did not call Python.
